about: Surgut International Airport, operator JSC Surgut Airport. The route network has more than 30 destinations. The terminal has business lounges, VIP lounges and jet bridges.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: City routes No. 16 and No. 107 run to the airport. Route maps and timetables are published on the Getting there page.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: The business lounge in the arrivals hall, Level 2 (by lift), is open round the clock and does not serve international flights. Access for business-class passengers and loyalty programme cardholders depends on the airline and the flight operated; economy-class passengers pay a fee. ON PASS lounge: Level 2 airside, domestic flights only, open round the clock, adult 3,500 ₽, child 2–12 years 2,500 ₽.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Open round the clock. The first day 400 ₽ (until 00:00), then 200 ₽ per day; a part day counts as a full day. One item may weigh up to 30 kg.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: On the airport terminal forecourt the first 20 minutes are free. A long-stay area for 50 cars right behind the bus shelter: 750 ₽ per day. Payment at the terminal payment counters and at machines by the main entrance and in the arrivals hall.
